Questions

Before you email

Yes. Travel within 60 km of downtown Toronto is included in every wedding collection. Beyond that we charge mileage at cost, plus accommodation if the day starts before 9am or ends after 10pm. We regularly photograph in Niagara, Muskoka, Prince Edward County and Ottawa, and we take on a handful of destination weddings each year.

For a Saturday in peak season (June, September, October) most couples book 12–18 months ahead. Off-season and weekday dates are often available with three to six months' notice. Send us the date either way — we'll tell you honestly whether it's open rather than creating false urgency.

A sneak peek of 20–30 images lands within 48 hours of the wedding. The complete gallery is delivered within six weeks — contractually, not aspirationally. Portrait and family sessions are delivered within two weeks. Albums take a further four to six weeks after your layout is approved.

No — and no reputable studio will hand those over. Raw files are unfinished work; the edit is a substantial part of what you're hiring us for. You receive every keeper as a full-resolution edited JPEG with a personal print release, which means you can print, share and archive them freely.

A 30% retainer and a signed contract hold your date; the balance is due 14 days before. We accept e-Transfer, credit card and bank transfer, and we offer interest-free payment plans on request. All prices on this page are in Canadian dollars and exclude HST, which is applied at 13% on your invoice.

Yes to both. We carry $2M commercial general liability insurance, which most Ontario venues require, and we're happy to send a certificate directly to your venue. Every photographer shoots on dual-card-slot bodies with backup bodies and lenses on site, and your files are backed up to two physical drives plus encrypted cloud storage the same night.

Our contract covers it. We maintain a network of vetted Toronto photographers whose work matches ours, and in the event of illness or emergency we arrange a replacement at our cost and edit the files ourselves so the final gallery still looks like our work. In eleven years we've used it twice.
